subject: Recap & Next Steps — Skyline evaluation and procurement timeline
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@skylinehealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & Next Steps — Skyline evaluation and procurement timeline

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed mutual action plan so we have a single source of truth. I bolded the immediate asks at the top.

Immediate asks (this week)
- Elaine: confirm list of stakeholders who must attend the technical deep-dive (names + roles).
- Procurement: confirm standard PO timeline and whether you need an initial pilot SOW or full-term SOW for vendor review.
- We: send updated MAP + SOC2 summary and first-draft SOW/pricing.

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: current latency spikes on high-concurrency inference during daily reporting windows; batching strategies are ad-hoc and causing cost overruns.
- Goal: reduce per-token cost by 30% and achieve 99.9% inference availability for peak windows; also need private deployment options for PHI.
- Success criteria: measurable latency P95 < 200ms for standard queries, cost-per-embed reduction target, and SOC2 evidence for security review.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level)
1) Week 1 (Dec 1–7): Technical deep-dive + scope capture (cloud topology, data residency, traffic profile). Owner: Redwood (Vivek + Marissa) + Skyline Eng (Elaine/Tom).
2) Week 2 (Dec 8–14): Pilot proposal + pricing + pilot SOW. Owner: Redwood (Marissa).
3) Week 3–4 (Dec 15–28): Pilot run (2–4 week pilot depending on traffic). Owner: Skyline Eng + Redwood infra team.
4) Week 5 (Jan 4): Pilot review & decision checkpoint — move to Dedicated/Private or expand hosted. Owner: Skyline PM + Procurement.

Open items we flagged during the call
- Data residency: you indicated US-only requirement for patient data; please confirm whether VPC or on-prem is required.
- Audit artifacts: procurement asked for SOC2 Type II summary and logging retention options. Attached: SOC2 summary.
- Pricing: baseline pilot pricing in attached SOW-pricing.xlsx is conservative; we can optimize after profiling.

Attachments: Skyline-MAP-draft.pdf (high-level milestones and owner table), SOW-pricing.xlsx (pilot pricing + options), SOC2-type2-summary.pdf

Next steps
- I’ll send a calendar invite for the technical deep-dive with proposed agenda and required attendees.
- Marissa will follow up with a first-pass pilot SOW by COB Friday (Dec 4).

Thanks — appreciate the pragmatic call.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
Redwood Inference — inference that scales
From: Elaine Park <elaine@skylinehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@skylinehealth.com>, procurement@skylinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:34:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap & Next Steps — Skyline evaluation and procurement timeline

Vivek — this looks great, thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and a couple of asks from our side: 

Short answers
- Stakeholders for deep-dive: Elaine Park (Eng lead), Tom Hsu (SRE), Priya Menon (Security), Miguel Alvarez (PM). I’ll forward their calendars after this note.
- Data residency: US-only for PHI; we prefer VPC in our AWS account if possible.
- Procurement timeline: procurement@skylinehealth.com needs the pilot SOW + estimated monthly spend to start an internal 2-week review. Typical turnaround is 7–10 business days.

Open questions
1) Can Redwood provide a brief network architecture example for VPC peering (or a diagram) before the deep-dive? Our security team wants to see the data flow for egress and KV caching.
2) Is there an option to run the KV cache on our side (customer-hosted) vs. Redwood-managed? Cost and performance tradeoffs would be useful to see.

We also need the SOC2 summary you attached; I’ve looped procurement but can you also send the full SOC2 Type II report (redacted acceptable) to procurement@skylinehealth.com?

I’ll confirm a few slots for the technical deep-dive — earliest we can do is Dec 3 in the morning.

On the pilot: we prefer a short pilot (2 weeks) focused on inference during peak reporting windows with a small set of representative queries. If the pilot demonstrates latency improvement and cost reduction, we’ll accelerate to an expanded pilot.

Thanks — Elaine

--
Elaine Park
Head of Engineering, Skyline Health
elaine@skylinehealth.com | (617) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@skylinehealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@skylinehealth.com>, procurement@skylinehealth.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap & Next Steps — Skyline evaluation and procurement timeline

Thanks Elaine — marking items and next steps. Short note to confirm what we’ll deliver this week and links to action items: 

Deliverables by COB Friday (Dec 4)
- Pilot SOW + conservative pricing (SOW-pricing.xlsx attached).
- VPC peering network diagram + short doc on options for KV cache (customer-hosted vs Redwood-managed).
- Full SOC2 Type II report (redacted) sent to procurement@skylinehealth.com.

Action items / invites
- I’ve created a 90-minute technical deep-dive on Dec 3 at 10:00 AM ET and sent a calendar invite to the attendees Elaine listed. Agenda: traffic profile, data flow, security controls, pilot scope. Please accept if that slot works.
- Procurement: to speed the PO review, we included an estimated monthly spend in SOW-pricing.xlsx and a short clause for pilot-termination terms. If you need alternative language, flag it and we’ll iterate quickly.

DocuSign and legal
- For procurement’s convenience we can route pilot SOW via DocuSign. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/link/skyline-sow-2026 (will be live when SOW is finalized).

Next week
- If pilot is approved, target start date Dec 15 (two-week run) with a review meeting on Jan 4 to decide rollout.

Attachments included in this thread: Skyline-MAP-draft.pdf, SOW-pricing.xlsx, SOC2-type2-summary.pdf

If any of the stakeholders want a pre-meeting sync or have specific queries for the deep-dive, drop them here and we’ll prep the right folks.

—
